currentWork.title: Field maintenance — OCR post-confirm flow + Today completion
currentWork.releaseStatus: FINAL.18 candidate is preview-verified. A real-device sales-journal path exposed that compact-review rerenders dropped the visit callbacks, so sales reports that required a field correction could confirm without showing the post-confirm capture/end choices. FINAL.18 preserves those callbacks across rerenders. Explicit OCR visit closeout now also routes the matched Today machine through the existing normal visit-completion flow, including the existing task checklist and order confirmation. Preview visit/overlap and OCR field regression gates pass. Analytics engine remains AN14B3B3; DB/schema remain 4.
scope: Preserve compact OCR mount callbacks across every material rerender so corrected sales journals keep the same visit session and post-confirm actions.
When the operator explicitly ends an OCR visit and the Analytics visit is linked to a machine in Today's target set, reuse the existing completeVisit flow to mark the Today machine visited.
Preserve the existing task confirmation before visit completion and the existing order handling/confirmation after task review.
Do not mark a Today machine visited merely by closing the OCR modal; only explicit OCR visit closeout triggers the legacy completion flow.
Do not infer a legacy machine when Analytics/OCR does not have a trusted machine link.
No numeric analytics change, auto-confirm, auto-link, or DB/schema migration.
nextActions: Verify production deployment, GitHub Pages version, and both regression gates live.
Return to real-device field verification, specifically sales-journal correction followed by post-confirm choices and OCR visit end with task/order cases.

unresolved: Production merge/live verification for FINAL.18 is pending.
